title: Slushie Bar Salts Pink Lemonade 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pink Lemonade by Slushie Bar Salts offers a delightful twist on a classic summer beverage, combining the tangy zest of traditional lemonade with a sweet berry infusion. This e-liquid captures the essence of a refreshing glass of pink lemonade on a sunny day, with a perfect balance of sour and sweet notes. Each inhale greets your tastebuds with the vibrant and zesty flavour of freshly squeezed lemons, creating a lively and refreshing sensation. This is beautifully complemented by a layer of sweet berry undertones, adding depth and a hint of summery sweetness to the mix. The result is an enchanting blend of flavours that is both invigorating and super-satisfying, making it an ideal choice for all-day vaping. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
